title: Subnet IP exhaustion in spoke
injected_fault: snet-app at 118/123 IPs and snet-data growing ~0.4 IPs/day; GatewaySubnet /28
symptom: Private endpoint and VM scale-out deployments in vnet-spoke1 fail because the subnet is full; IP address exhaustion with no available IPs left, and we need a capacity forecast and address space headroom.
